external_entities.name: Supplier
external_entities.description: An external supplier that provides documents and supplier information.
external_entities.notes: The diagram does not distinguish whether Supplier is an individual or an organisation; represented as a human actor.

processes.name: Supplier document portal
processes.description: A vendor-hosted portal receiving supplier documents and category-manager decisions, and producing a nightly supplier data extract.

processes.name: Supplier master service
processes.description: A service that loads a file from the landing bucket and sends supplier records to the supplier database.

processes.name: Category manager
processes.description: A category manager who reviews, approves, or rejects items in the supplier document portal.

data_stores.name: Landing bucket
data_stores.description: A cloud landing bucket receiving a nightly supplier data extract and a file loaded by the supplier master service.

data_stores.name: Supplier database
data_stores.description: A database receiving supplier records from the supplier master service.

data_flows.description: A nightly supplier data extract in CSV format sent from the supplier document portal to the landing bucket.

assumptions.assumption: Supplier is represented as a human external entity because the diagram shows it initiating the submission of documents, while it does not identify an automated supplier system.
assumptions.basis: The diagram labels the actor as "Supplier" and shows it sending documents to the portal, but does not specify whether the actor is a person, organisation, or automated system.
